test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
'B + D' means 'B is the father-in-law of D'.

'B & D' means 'B is the brother of D'.

'B # D' means 'B is the wife of D'.

'B $ D' means 'B is the son of D'.

'B @ D' means 'B is the mother of D'.

If O is the only child of his parents, then which of the given options is true in reference to the following expression?

M # L & N @ O $ P + R

options.text: R is the wife of O.
N has only one son and one daughter
N is the mother of R.

solution:
Family Chart : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 **Symbol**
 &
 #
 $
 +
 @
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Brother
 Wife
 Son
 Father-in-law
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: M # L & N @ O $ P + R

It gives, M is the wife of L, L is the brother of N, N is the mother of O, O is the son of P, P is the father-in-law of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d54fbae5289eaa1692dda3730c40f11a8b21a8b9e6dbad4058b78d64c0cc2ca0.png] 

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) R is the wife of O - True**

Option 2) L and P are siblings - False

Option 3) N has only one son and one daughter - False

Option 4) N is the mother of R - False

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
